Name: Teleportation Portal - Stardew Valley
Author: bRighToVictory
Description: The Mod gives you a portal if you press the letter I, and you can also remove it with the letter i. Every time you use the portal, you can teleport to JojaMart, the Farm, Pierre's Store, the cinders forest, the town house, and the mines. Before you save the game, the portal is removed to prevent crashes. You lose half your energy with every teleportation.
